tests.test: charge every layer by a universal constant times eventual density
tests.reason: the exact binary tower has amplification asymptotic to Q/(2 log Q)

tests.test: use a one-step lcm-age potential with no stored reserve
tests.reason: a positive-density two-layer block spends at least 1.309 times its local eventual-density budget

tests.test: bound target-isolated CRT matching number from positive density
tests.reason: distinct prime moduli with residue zero give arbitrarily large pairwise target-isolated matchings over the full previous survivor

tests.test: concatenate finite blocks without a scale-preserving interface
tests.reason: every fixed block dilutes by 1/log x at later cutoffs and the search supplies no cross-block noninterference invariant

tests.test: charge a layer by density times one plus log(period/onset)
tests.reason: the binary tower has ratio Q/log Q while its log period/onset charge is only logarithmic

tests.test: charge lcm-cell entropy only once across nested layers
tests.reason: multiple onset layers reuse the same low-order sparse congruence cell, so a period-only entropy debit double counts its reserve
